newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-YANKEES SIGN WHITEN, RE-SIGN SOJO.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-YANKEES SIGN WHITEN, RE-SIGN SOJO.

text.p: The New York Yankees continued retooling for the 1997 season by signing free agent outfielder Mark Whiten and re-signing utility infielder Luis Sojo on Thursday to one-year contracts.

Whiten, 30, split the 1996 season with Philadelphia, Atlanta and Seattle, batting a combined .262 with 22 homers and 71 RBI in 136 games. He is best known for blasting four homers and driving in 12 runs for St. Louis in Cincinnati in 1993.
Sojo, 31, was acquired off waivers from Seattle last August and hit .275 with two doubles and five RBI in 18 games for the Yanks. In 95 games overall last year, he batted .220.
